next.notes: App Router with Turbopack. SSR is used for public customer approval pages (no auth required on those routes). Kanban board and RO builder are client components. react-pdf and dnd-kit both require dynamic imports with ssr: false.

react.notes: React 19 — concurrent features and use() hook available. Pairs well with Supabase Realtime via useEffect subscriptions on the kanban board.

tailwindcss.notes: Tailwind v4. No tailwind.config.js — configuration lives in globals.css via @theme inline directive. CSS variables from v1Pandas.css are exposed as Tailwind utilities (bg-primary, text-foreground, etc.). Required by shadcn/ui.

dnd-kit.notes: Kanban drag-and-drop for the RO board. Must be loaded with next/dynamic + ssr: false — dnd-kit uses browser APIs unavailable during SSR. Use @dnd-kit/core for sensors and @dnd-kit/sortable for column ordering.

react-pdf.notes: Client-side invoice PDF generation directly from RO data — no server involvement. Must be dynamically imported with ssr: false. Alternative: html2canvas if layout fidelity over a React tree is preferred.

supabase.notes: Core backend. Row-level security (RLS) scoped to shop_id is the security model for all tables — every policy filters by auth.uid() → shop_id. Two Supabase clients are needed: createServerClient (server components, API routes) and createBrowserClient (client components). Realtime subscriptions power live kanban updates when cards change status. Storage used for DVI photo uploads (Week 2+).

vercel.notes: Deploys directly from Git. SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY must be set in Vercel environment variables. Preview deployments get their own Supabase branch if Supabase branching is enabled.

stripe.notes: Stripe Connect (not standard Stripe) — shops are sub-accounts, Pandas Tech takes a platform fee. Requires onboarding flow for each shop owner. Webhooks must be handled for payment confirmation before marking RO as paid.

twilio.notes: SMS delivery for customer approval links. MVP bypasses this entirely — shop copies the public URL and pastes it into a text manually. Twilio is additive and does not change the approval page or RO data model.

next-pwa.notes: Progressive Web App wrapper so techs can add the app to their home screen. Service worker for offline RO viewing. Install prompt should appear on first visit on mobile.

posthog.notes: Initialize once in a client-side PostHogProvider wrapping the app. Use posthog.identify() on login with shop_id so all events are scoped per shop. Avoid over-tracking — one event per meaningful action.
kpis: time from signup to first RO saved
weekly active shops (shops with ≥1 ro_status_changed in 7 days)

shadcn-ui.notes: shadcn/ui — CLI-based component library built on Radix UI + Tailwind. Components live as source in client/src/components/ui/ and are owned by us (no npm update). Themed via CSS variables in v1Pandas.css — no createTheme() needed. Add components on demand: npx shadcn@latest add <name>. Starter set already added: button, card, input, label, textarea, form, badge, dialog, sheet, dropdown-menu, select, checkbox, radio-group, switch, tabs, table, separator, avatar, tooltip, popover, sonner, skeleton, alert, alert-dialog, scroll-area.

lucide-react.notes: Icon library used by shadcn components. Import icons individually (import { Wrench } from 'lucide-react') — never import the whole package.

next-themes.notes: Dark mode via system preference. ThemeProvider in layout.tsx uses attribute='class', defaultTheme='system', enableSystem. next-themes sets .dark on <html> based on prefers-color-scheme. No UI toggle in MVP — the .dark class wires to v1Pandas dark palette automatically.

v1Pandas.notes: Single source of truth bridge between the design system and shadcn. Run npm run build:tokens to regenerate after token changes. v1Pandas.css contains :root and .dark CSS variable blocks consumed by shadcn. v1Pandas.json is the alias-resolved JSON for any non-CSS consumer. Both files are generated — do not edit by hand.

recharts.notes: Added via npx shadcn@latest add chart which installs Recharts v3 and the ChartContainer/ChartTooltip wrappers. chart-1 through chart-5 CSS variables in v1Pandas.css are already wired for it.
